Fonts bundled with Nodalis
==========================

All four are licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1, which permits
bundling and redistribution with an application. Full licence text:
https://openfontlicense.org

  Inter          — Rasmus Andersson.      https://rsms.me/inter/
  Space Grotesk  — Florian Karsten.       https://floriankarsten.github.io/space-grotesk/
  Space Mono     — Colophon Foundry.      https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Space+Mono
  Doto           — Adam Jagosz.           https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Doto

Only the latin subset at weights 400/500/700 is included, to keep the offline
download small. Sourced via the @fontsource packages.
